label: PF Backlog 517
title: Defect/RCCA: traceability.json has TWO writers (core/traceability.py vs requirement_link.py) + registry concern mismatch
body:
## Problem / why
`products/<name>/traceability.json` has TWO writers: `core/traceability.py` (declared owner in
config/store-registry.json; TraceabilityMatrix: requirement->design->architecture->implementation->test->security
+ id_index hub, "preserving the legacy matrix") AND `core/requirement_link.py` (writes the REQ<->F matrix into the
same file). Also the store-registry "concern" text for traceability.json describes an "append-only engineering
change log" - which matches neither module (likely a copy/paste drift from change_log.json).

## Goal & value
ONE writer for traceability.json (the registered owner, core/traceability.py), with requirement_link contributing
data instead of writing the file; the registry concern text matches reality.

## Acceptance criteria
- Only core/traceability.py writes products/<name>/traceability.json.
- requirement_link no longer writes it directly (delegates its REQ<->F rows to the owner).
- store-registry concern for traceability.json describes the requirement/id traceability matrix (not a change log).

## In scope
Reconcile the writer + fix the registry concern.

## Out of scope
Populating the matrix flags (that is E8).

## Verification
A test asserts requirement_link does not write traceability.json (owner-only writer).

## 5-Why
1. Two modules wrote one store. 2. requirement_link created a matrix before core/traceability.py existed. 3.
core/traceability.py later took ownership ("preserving the legacy matrix") but requirement_link kept writing. 4. No
gate enforced the single writer for this store. 5. Guard: requirement_link delegates; store-registry owner is
authoritative.
